distractorExplanations.a: Condensation risk applies to cooling setup in humid climates; winter setback with radiation is a morning recovery issue.
distractorExplanations.c: Ventilation minimums apply during occupancy; unoccupied setback mode can close outdoor air.
distractorExplanations.d: Chilled-water reset is a cooling plant strategy; night setback evaluation centers on morning heating recovery.
